rows: You have only a short record set.

text: Choose a measurement or clarification that reduces the largest material uncertainty first.

items: Electricity (kWh) = load (kW) x runtime (hours).
Mixed site GJ = electricity kWh x 0.0036 + fuel GJ.
Energy use intensity = annual GJ / conditioned floor area in m2.
Average kW = billed kWh / interval hours.
Load factor = kWh / (peak kW x interval hours).
Energy charge = billed kWh x energy rate.
Demand charge = billed kW x relevant demand rate, subject to tariff rules.
Daily kWh = occupied kW x occupied hours + reduced kW x other hours.
Annual saved kWh = avoided kW x affected hours.
Simple payback (years) = installed cost / annual net currency savings.
NPV = -initial cost + sum of net annual cash flow / (1 + discount rate)^year.
System COP = useful heating or cooling power / input power.
Motor or boiler input = useful output / efficiency as a decimal.
Lighting efficacy = lumens / watts.
Lighting power density = installed watts / area in m2.
For series layers, R-total = sum of layer R; matching U = 1 / R-total.
For balanced three-phase systems, real kW = sqrt(3) x line V x A x power factor / 1000.
Water thermal kW = flow (kg/s) x heat capacity (kJ/kg-K) x delta temperature (K).
